ending_hook: Across the yard, Yoon Ha-eun stood at the hall door with her tablet against her hip, watching the two of them the way a surveyor watches a ceiling.
summary_l1: The morning after the Mapo run. The Association suspends Gate 3 pending reinspection because of the anomalous cores, and Do-yoon realises his own success changed a future he was relying on. A survey-division officer questions him about the third chamber and he gives her nothing. In the yard Mu-jin presses him directly, is refused, and keeps him at eighteen percent anyway. Do-yoon reaches for Thursday and finds no memory of it at all.
